newsitem.title: USA: Apogee Q3 earnings likely below forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Apogee Q3 earnings likely below forecasts.

text.p: Apogee Inc said Tuesday it expects its third-quarter earnings will be lower than the analysts' consensus forecast of $0.07 per share, although it still expects to post a profit in that period.

The company cited several reasons for the shortfall, including a slower-than-expected summer season and a delay in recognizing revenue from new contracts that originally was to be posted in the third quarter.
It also attributed it to higher use than expected of the company's self-insured health program and delays in acquisitions that were to have closed in the third quarter.
Revenue from the new contracts is now expected to be recognized in this year's fourth quarter and on January 1, 1997, the company said.

Apogee President Lawrence Davies said that although the company will not meet analysts' expectations, it is continuing to make progress in the third quarter, as well as since the beginning of the year.

He added that the company is looking for ways to cut costs. It also said that legislation pending in Congress that would guarantee mental-health benefits in employee insurance plans should lead to positive results in the company's future.
The company's third-quarter results are expected to be announced in early November.
